title.ko: 양보 구문: however · whatever · albeit · much as · try as + 주어 + might
title.en: advanced concession: however, whatever, albeit, much as, try as + subject + might

explain.ko: 양보 구문은 앞의 내용이 뒤의 결과와 반대일 때 씁니다. however/whatever/whoever + 절은 '아무리 ~해도'를 뜻하고(However hard he tried, ...), much as나 try as + 주어 + might는 '하긴 하지만, 아무리 해도'라는 뜻입니다. albeit는 '비록 ~이지만'으로 형용사나 부사 앞에 쓰며, notwithstanding은 격식 있는 전치사입니다. whereas와 while은 두 가지를 대조할 때 쓰입니다. 에세이, 보도, 공식 연설에서 입장을 유보하며 말할 때 유용합니다.
explain.en: Concessive structures are used when the main clause is contrary to what the first part suggests. However/whatever/whoever + clause means 'no matter how/what/who' (However hard he tried, ...), and much as or try as + subject + might means 'although I like it' or 'however hard we try'. Albeit means 'although it is' before an adjective or adverb, and notwithstanding is a formal preposition. Whereas and while contrast two things. They are useful in essays, news and speeches.

notes.en: Albeit is followed by an adjective or adverb, not a full clause.

notes.ko: Try as we might 구문에는 조동사 might가 자주 붙습니다.
notes.en: Try as we might often takes the modal might.

notes.ko: although와 though는 같은 의미이지만 even though가 더 강합니다.
notes.en: Although and though are similar, but even though is stronger.

prompt.ko: 양보 표현(however, albeit, much as, try as)을 사용해 어려운 상황에서의 입장을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about a position in a difficult situation using concessive structures.

task.model: The plan is expensive, albeit likely to pay off in the long run. However strong the opposition, we will continue to pursue this policy. Much as I like the proposal, we lack the budget. Should both sides make concessions, agreement is quite possible.

model_trans.ko: 그 계획은 비용이 많이 들지만 장기적으로 이익이 될 것입니다. 아무리 반대가 거세도 우리는 이 정책을 계속 추진할 것입니다. 그 제안이 마음에 들긴 하지만 예산이 부족합니다. 양측이 양보한다면 합의는 충분히 가능합니다.
model_trans.en: The plan is expensive, albeit likely to pay off in the long run. However strong the opposition, we will continue to pursue this policy. Much as I like the proposal, we lack the budget. Should both sides make concessions, agreement is quite possible.
